second_answer_attack.resolution: ABCB11/PFIC2 is a serious low-GGT differential, but chronic diarrhea and sensorineural hearing loss are established extrahepatic features that are more characteristic of ATP8B1 deficiency and resolve the single-best-answer competition.

item.lead_in: Which hepatocyte transport process is most directly impaired?
item.tested_construct: ABCB11 encodes the bile salt export pump (BSEP), an ATP-binding cassette transporter on the canalicular membrane of hepatocytes that mediates biliary bile-acid export. BSEP deficiency causes PFIC2 with cholestasis and typically low or normal GGT.

blind_audit.rationale: ATP8B1 deficiency causes a spectrum that includes PFIC1. Severe disease presents with early cholestasis, intense pruritus, high serum bile acids, and low/normal GGT. Extrahepatic manifestations such as chronic diarrhea, pancreatic disease, and hearing loss are particularly useful clues favoring ATP8B1 deficiency over other low-GGT PFIC disorders. Strongest alternative resolved: ABCB11/PFIC2 is a serious low-GGT differential, but chronic diarrhea and sensorineural hearing loss are established extrahepatic features that are more characteristic of ATP8B1 deficiency and resolve the single-best-answer competition.
